Error items of a document or of step outputs

Source: R/doc.R
pub_error_items.Rd

Finds the failed steps in a document or in the outputs placed into one, e.g. to check a report before it is rendered (pub_render() refuses error items) or to list its problems in an app.

Usage

pub_error_items(x)

Arguments

x

A document (pub_doc()), a section (pub_section()) or step outputs: failure objects of failed steps, error items of pub_out(), other outputs and lists of them (nested). Objects of other classes are converted with as_pub_output() first, as in a document.

Value

A list of error items (class pub_error, as returned by pub_out()), in document order; empty if there are none. An error item is a list with the elements step (the step whose output it replaces), failed_step (the step that failed), message (its error message) and, for an item of pub_out(), pipeline (the pipeline of the steps).

See also

pub_out()

Examples

p <- pipeflow::pip_new("air") |>
    pipeflow::pip_add("data", \() airquality) |>
    pipeflow::pip_add("fit", \(data = ~data) stop("too few values")) |>
    pipeflow::pip_add("table", \(fit = ~fit) coef(fit))
suppressWarnings(pipeflow::pip_run(p, on_error = "continue"))
#> info [2026-11-14 08:20:06.536 UTC]: Starting run of pipeflow 'air'
#> info [2026-11-14 08:20:06.537 UTC]: Step 1/3 data
#> info [2026-11-14 08:20:06.538 UTC]: Step 2/3 fit
#> error [2026-11-14 08:20:06.538 UTC]: too few values
#> info [2026-11-14 08:20:06.539 UTC]: Step 3/3 table - skipping step, input 'fit' failed
#> info [2026-11-14 08:20:06.539 UTC]: Finished in 0.003 s (1 done, 1 skipped, 1 failed)
#> warn [2026-11-14 08:20:06.540 UTC]: Run of pipeline 'air' continued after 1 failed step:
#>   'fit': too few values
#> Steps not run because an input failed: 'table'

parts <- list(
    Data = head(airquality),
    Fit = pub_out(p, "table", on_error = "item")
)
errors <- pub_error_items(parts)
length(errors)
#> [1] 1
errors[[1]]$message
#> [1] "too few values"

pub_error_items(pub_doc(parts))[[1]]$failed_step
#> [1] "fit"
